text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut. Air Groove 
receives words of encouragement from 
Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by their support, Air Groove 
heads toward her Make Debut race to answer 
the cheering of her juniors.
